	}

		}
		set_temp_variable = {

		}
		change_relative_party_popularity = yes

	}

country_event = {
	id = dsw_tfr_russia.623
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		SOV = {
			has_country_flag = DSW_SOV_tfr_active
		}
		tag = SOV
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = SOV_nav_oligarch_subdued_flag
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		set_country_flag = SOV_oligarchs_investment
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_event_target = SOV_oligarchs_investment_state
			}
			clear_global_event_target = SOV_oligarchs_investment_state
		}
		random_list = {
			545 = {
				modifier = {
					NOT = {
						any_owned_state = {
							is_core_of = ROOT
							is_controlled_by = ROOT
							free_building_slots = {
								building = industrial_complex
								size > 0
								include_locked = no
							}
						}
					}
					factor = 0
				}
				random_owned_state = {
					limit = {
						is_core_of = ROOT
						is_controlled_by = ROOT
						free_building_slots = {
							building = industrial_complex
							size > 0
							include_locked = no
						}
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = SOV_oligarchs_investment_state
					state_event = {
						id = dsw_tfr_russia.622
						trigger_for = controller
					}
				}
			}
			1064 = {
				modifier = {
					NOT = {
						any_owned_state = {
							is_core_of = ROOT
							is_controlled_by = ROOT
							free_building_slots = {
								building = arms_factory
								size > 0
								include_locked = no
							}
						}
					}
					factor = 0
				}
				modifier = {
					has_country_flag = DSW_SOV_pending_focus_SOV_build_up_western_military_district_UR
					factor = 2
				}
				random_owned_state = {
					limit = {
						is_core_of = ROOT
						is_controlled_by = ROOT
						free_building_slots = {
							building = arms_factory
							size > 0
							include_locked = no
						}
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = SOV_oligarchs_investment_state
					state_event = {
						id = dsw_tfr_russia.624
						trigger_for = controller
					}
				}
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			country_event = {
				id = dsw_tfr_russia.623
				days = 365
				random_days = 10
			}
		}
	}
